comment: The full engine REGISTRY, droidtop-authored (no upstream frontend maintains these). v4 (direction 2026-08-31): detection, launch routing, and enginehost vocabulary all live HERE so new engines/contexts ship as a database update, not an app rebuild. Per engine: 'detect' is an ordered list of rules (rules OR, conditions within a rule AND; first matching engine in file order wins; condition types: dirExists, fileExists, anyFileNameContains, anyFileExtension, anyFileNameIn, dirNamePrefixCount, fileHeadRegex (case-insensitive, first 4KB), builtin (named code probe for byte-magic checks JSON cannot express)); 'strategies' is launch priority (names match droidtop's GameLaunchStrategy enum; availability stays code - the database only decides which available strategy WINS); 'enginehost' is the family/context vocabulary from enginehost-contract.md's own table (context null = droidtop cannot determine it, launch opens enginehost's CONFIGURE screen prefilled). Engine EMULATORS (EasyRPG, Kirikiroid2, Ruffle, ...) are NOT declared here: engines are systems, and apps that emulate engines live in players-database.json exactly like apps that emulate consoles. Plain .swf is deliberately the players-database path (Ruffle etc., systemId flash), so flash-air's detection stays the AIR package shape. JoiPlay is deliberately absent everywhere: it exposes no consumable launch surface.

engines.notes: Ren'Py ships py/sh/exe launchers together; Linux path preferred over Wine when both exist.
MV/MZ are nw.js exports; Linux only when the export includes it.

RGSS runtimes are Windows-only. Ruby 1.9.2 is RGSS3's own real pairing - enginehost's config editor prefills exactly this for detected VX Ace. The Game.ini Library line is the engine declaring its own RGSS build; the .rgss3a check tolerates renamed archives (real install: Game.rgss3a.old).
RGSS2 line: .rgss2a archive, Game.rvproj project marker, or the Game.ini Library=RGSS2xx declaration. Listed after vxace so the more specific RGSS3 evidence wins first.
RGSS1 line: .rgssad archive, Game.rxproj project marker, or Game.ini Library=RGSS1xx.

Context null on purpose: RPG_RT.exe/.ldb proves the 2000/2003 FAMILY but not which generation; launch opens enginehost's CONFIGURE screen prefilled. The easyrpg PLAYER entries in players-database.json remain the alternate path (engines are systems).

versionSelectorFallback 0 is a selector fall-through, not a version claim: by the engine's own semantics anything that maps to no implementation string selects the sole default. Device-confirmed 2026-08-31. KIRIKIROID2 strategy predates the unified player entry; both point at the same app.
August is not a separate enginehost family: buriko with the August context, per the contract.
ps2 vs ps3 generation undetermined by the cmvs32/cmvs64/cmvs.cfg signature; CONFIGURE flow.
Detection is specifically the AIR package shape, so the air context is the real answer, not a coin flip. Plain .swf goes through the flash player entries in players-database.json (Ruffle etc.).
HTML export; the builtin probe reads the first 512KB of root .html files for tw-storydata/twinejs/SugarCube/Harlowe.
The builtin probe covers both the loose .pck shape and the embedded-pack GDPC trailer that JSON conditions cannot express.
Not an enginehost family; PC runtime strategies only.
Not an enginehost family. The builtin probe searches UnityPlayer.dll/.so/.dylib up to 3 folders deep (real Linux-export fix).
